title: TokenAggregate
description: Rolling token-spend totals for one project over a time window. Stored in logs/tokens/<project>.jsonl, one record per closed window. Drives the token-spend timeline used by the security-review evidence chain and the workspace-wide usage hover modal.

windowStart.description: Inclusive UTC start of the aggregation window.

windowEnd.description: Exclusive UTC end of the aggregation window.

cli.description: Which CLI produced the tokens. Aggregates are kept per CLI because pricing and budget windows differ.

model.description: Concrete model id used during the window, e.g. claude-opus-4-7.

input.description: Total input tokens consumed in this window.

output.description: Total output tokens produced in this window.

cacheRead.description: Tokens read from prompt cache when the CLI exposes the metric.

cacheWrite.description: Tokens written to prompt cache when the CLI exposes the metric.

dollars.description: Optional dollar estimate for the window when pricing is known. Null when only token counts are available (subscription-based usage).

jobIds.description: Job ids whose runs contributed to this window, ordered chronologically. Empty when the window covered no runs.

jobsCompleted.description: How many jobs reached 4-review or 5-completed during the window. Useful for tokens-per-completed-task metrics.
